description: Implementation class for the PersonService interface in the openmrs-core project, providing methods for managing Person, PersonName, PersonAttribute, Relationship, and related entities including CRUD operations, batch retrieval, and serialization handling.

classes.name: PersonServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the PersonService interface, providing concrete methods for handling Person-related operations, including CRUD, relationship management, attribute types, serialization logs, and address handling within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: setPersonDAO
methods.description: Sets the DAO (Data Access Object) responsible for persistence operations related to Person entities.

methods.name: getSimilarPeople
methods.description: Retrieves a set of people similar to the provided name, birth year, and gender.

methods.name: getPeople
methods.description: Fetches a list of Person objects matching the search phrase, with optional filters for deceased and voided status.

methods.name: getAllPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all person attribute types, including retired ones.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Finds a person attribute type by its name.

methods.name: purgePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a specified person attribute type after checking for locks.

methods.name: savePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a PersonAttributeType, handling sort weight and global property updates.

methods.name: retirePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Marks a PersonAttributeType as retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretirePersonAttributeType
methods.description: Unretires a PersonAttributeType, making it active again.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypes
methods.description: Fetches person attribute types by various criteria (name, format, foreign key, searchable).

methods.name: getPersonAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getPersonAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttribute by its ID.

methods.name: getRelationship
methods.description: Fetches a Relationship entity by its ID.

methods.name: getRelationshipType
methods.description: Fetches a RelationshipType entity by its ID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeByName
methods.description: Finds a RelationshipType by its name.

methods.name: purgePerson
methods.description: Deletes a Person entity.

methods.name: savePerson
methods.description: Saves or updates a Person, ensuring preferred name and address are set.

methods.name: voidPerson
methods.description: Marks a Person as voided (currently only saves the person; void logic may be elsewhere).

methods.name: unvoidPerson
methods.description: Unvoids a Person.

methods.name: getPerson
methods.description: Retrieves a Person by its ID.

methods.name: getAllRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships, with optional inclusion of voided ones.

methods.name: getRelationships
methods.description: Retrieves relationships matching given persons and relationship type.

methods.name: purgeRelationship
methods.description: Deletes a Relationship entity.

methods.name: saveRelationship
methods.description: Saves or updates a Relationship entity.

methods.name: voidRelationship
methods.description: Voids a relationship, potentially with a reason (though the method implementation just saves).

methods.name: unvoidRelationship
methods.description: Restores a relationship from voided status.

methods.name: getAllRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all relationship types, including retired if specified.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypes
methods.description: Searches for relationship types by name and preferred status.

methods.name: purgeRelationshipType
methods.description: Deletes a RelationshipType.

methods.name: saveRelationshipType
methods.description: Saves a RelationshipType, validating description.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypes (overload with personType and viewType)
methods.description: Retrieves person attribute types based on person type and view type, combining global properties.

methods.name: parsePersonName
methods.description: Parses a string into a PersonName object, handling various name formats.

methods.name: getRelationshipMap
methods.description: Builds a map of people and their related persons for a specified relationship type.

methods.name: getPersonAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: getPersonByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Person by UUID.

methods.name: savePersonMergeLog
methods.description: Saves a merge log of persons, serializing merge data.

methods.name: getPersonMergeLogByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a PersonMergeLog by UUID, with optional deserialization.

methods.name: getAllPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves all person merge logs with optional deserialization.

methods.name: getWinningPersonMergeLogs
methods.description: Retrieves merge logs where the specified person is the winner.

methods.name: getLosingPersonMergeLog
methods.description: Retrieves the merge log where the person is the loser.

methods.name: getRelationshipByUuid
methods.description: Gets a relationship by UUID.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeByUuid
methods.description: Gets a relationship type by UUID.

methods.name: getAllRelationshipTypes (with includeRetired)
methods.description: Retrieves all relationship types, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: retireRelationshipType
methods.description: Marks a RelationshipType as retired with a reason.

methods.name: unretireRelationshipType
methods.description: Unretires a RelationshipType.

methods.name: voidPersonAddress
methods.description: Voids a PersonAddress.

methods.name: unvoidPersonAddress
methods.description: Unvoids a PersonAddress.

methods.name: savePersonAddress
methods.description: Saves or updates a PersonAddress.

methods.name: checkIfPersonAttributeTypesAreLocked
methods.description: Checks if the global property locks person attribute types from editing, throws exception if locked.
